client_transport: strangertest.handle.TasksHTTPTransport (HTTPTransport modern=True + Mcp-Name=taskId on tasks/*), MCP 2026-07-28, tasks extension declared in _meta clientCapabilities
gateway_config_run:
# TASK-HANDLE gate: agentgateway in front of the practice task server, with
# RFC 8693 TOKEN EXCHANGE (the compliant config: no token passthrough). Ports
# are double-brace placeholders; the driver (integration/handle_gateway_gate.py)
# writes a port-substituted copy to a scratch dir and refuses to run with any
# placeholder left, or with a port outside its block. Everything is
# loopback-only: agentgateway binds all interfaces by default, so every
# listener is pinned to 127.0.0.1 and stats / readiness are off.
#   client --(user JWT + x-actor-token)--> agentgateway 4601  (jwtAuth: local AS JWKS)
#   agentgateway --(token exchange, delegation)--> local AS 4600/token
#   agentgateway --(the exchanged token: aud = the upstream, act = the agent)-->
#     practice task server 4602/mcp
# The practice server runs with identity_from="jwt": the caller is the
# exchanged token's (orig_iss or iss, sub), so users A and B stay distinct
# even though each request may carry a freshly exchanged token.
config:
  adminAddr: 127.0.0.1:4603
  statsAddr: "off"
  readinessAddr: "off"
gateways:
  handle:
    port: 4601
    bindAddress: 127.0.0.1
routes:
- name: handle-mcp
  gateways: handle
  policies:
    jwtAuth:
      mode: strict
      providers:
      - issuer: https://local-as.test
        audiences: [agentgateway-api]
        jwks:
          url: http://127.0.0.1:4600/jwks
  backends:
  - mcp:
      statefulMode: stateful
      targets:
      - name: tasks
        mcp:
          host: http://127.0.0.1:4602/mcp
        policies:
          backendAuth:
            oauthTokenExchange:
              host: 127.0.0.1:4600
              path: /token
              subjectToken:
                source:
                  expression: jwt.rawToken.unredacted()
                tokenType: urn:ietf:params:oauth:token-type:jwt
              actorToken:
                source:
                  header:
                    name: x-actor-token
                tokenType: urn:ietf:params:oauth:token-type:jwt
              audiences: [https://upstream.test/mcp]
              scopes: [read:notes]
upstream_auth: token exchange: backendAuth.oauthTokenExchange swaps the validated user JWT (subject) and the agent's x-actor-token (actor) at the local AS for a token with aud=https://upstream.test/mcp and act=the agent
backendauth_key_documented: agentgateway docs, 'Static keys and passthrough' (standalone, latest): https://agentgateway.dev/docs/standalone/latest/documentation/configuration/security/backend-authn/key/ - 'Static key (key) sends a value that you configure, either inline or from a file on disk.'
agentgateway v1.7.0 generated config reference schema/config.md: <BackendPolicies>.backendAuth.key (with .file), next to backendAuth.passthrough ('Forward the validated incoming JWT to the backend.')
agentgateway v1.7.0 crates/agentgateway/src/http/auth/mod.rs BackendAuthKind::Key: 'Send a configured secret value, or a value computed from the request, to the backend.'
source_evidence: agentgateway v1.7.0 crates/agentgateway/src/mcp/session.rs:736-756: GetTask/UpdateTask/CancelTask requests are parsed, authorized only by the configured static mcpAuthorization policy (authorize_task_request, session.rs:256-280: ResourceType::Task(target, taskId) against CEL rules), then sent to the upstream (send_single). No binding of a taskId to the user who created it.
handler.rs:205-237: taskIds in CreateTaskResult/GetTaskResult are rewritten to '<target>+<id>' only when there is no default target (multiplexing); with one target they pass through unchanged.
streamablehttp.rs:428-441: tasks/* are name-bearing; the Mcp-Name header must equal params.taskId, else -32020 'invalid MCP routing header'.
